top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improperly Controlled Modification of Object Prototype Attributes ('Prototype Pollution')
top_sast_rules.description: Attacker-controlled object keys modify Object prototype attributes.
top_sast_rules.pattern: cwe-1321 prototype-pollution __proto__ constructor prototype object-key property-key merge assign recursive-merge
top_sast_rules.remediation: Reject prototype keys and use schema-constrained object updates.

top_sast_rules.description: Processing user-controlled object hierarchies inefficiently can lead to denial of service.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for operations that can consume excessive resources without proper limits or controls
top_sast_rules.remediation: Implement resource consumption limits, rate limiting, and proper cleanup mechanisms for all operations.

top_sast_rules.description: Assigning to a property of a primitive value has no effect and may trigger a runtime error.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization
top_sast_rules.remediation: Implement secure coding practices specific to CWE-704. Review OWASP guidelines and CWE documentation for detailed mitigation strategies.

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
top_sast_rules.description: Modifying an object obtained via a user-controlled property name may lead to accidental mutation of the built-in Object prototype, and possibly escalate to remote code execution or cross-site scripting.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization
top_sast_rules.remediation: Implement proper output encoding based on context (HTML, JavaScript, CSS, URL). Use Content Security Policy and validate input.

top_sast_rules.description: Listing the same property twice in one object literal is redundant and may indicate a copy-paste mistake.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization
top_sast_rules.remediation: Remove unused variables that may contain sensitive data. Use static analysis tools to identify unused code. Review code for potential logic errors.

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Function Call With Incorrect Number of Arguments
top_sast_rules.description: A function is invoked with extra trailing arguments that are ignored.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization
top_sast_rules.remediation: Implement secure coding practices specific to CWE-685. Review OWASP guidelines and CWE documentation for detailed mitigation strategies.

top_sast_rules.description: Using cookies without CSRF protection may allow malicious websites to submit requests on behalf of the user.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Find state-changing operations that lack CSRF protection mechanisms
top_sast_rules.remediation: Implement CSRF tokens for all state-changing operations. Use SameSite cookie attributes and validate the Origin/Referer headers.

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Argument Delimiters in a Command ('Argument Injection')
top_sast_rules.description: Forwarding command-line arguments to a child process executed within a shell may indirectly introduce command-line injection vulnerabilities.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization
top_sast_rules.remediation: Implement secure coding practices specific to CWE-088. Review OWASP guidelines and CWE documentation for detailed mitigation strategies.

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output
top_sast_rules.description: Replacing a substring with itself has no effect and may indicate a mistake.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Detect output operations that lack proper encoding for the target context
top_sast_rules.remediation: Use context-appropriate encoding for all output. Implement proper encoding libraries for HTML, JavaScript, URL, and CSS contexts.
